agent_answer.root_cause: The current source tree contains only a minimal TileLink passthrough adapter with no cache implementation, prefetcher, or MMIO address filtering. Based on the issue description, the bug occurs when prefetch requests cross from valid memory (0x7fffffc0) into MMIO space (0x80000000+), causing a system hang. The root cause is the absence of MMIO address range checking in the prefetcher logic before issuing prefetch requests. When a cache line access near the MMIO boundary triggers a prefetch, the next cache line falls into MMIO space, and MMIO accesses likely block indefinitely or cause undefined behavior in the cache pipeline.
